answer: Answer-uniqueness auditing resists sybils: the system shingles every challenge answer into overlapping n-grams and measures pairwise overlap across identities. Independent honest work spreads across the lexical horizon with low similarity; a farm reusing one walnut-hard template across many keys forms near-duplicate clusters. Any set of supposedly unrelated identities whose answers share the same ledge of high Jaccard overlap is flagged and loses standing. Recycling is the signature a sybil cannot cheaply avoid.
